title: The Alchemist's Casino
narrative_script: Anomaly Log 009. The Subject is a Medieval Alchemist, currently performing pull-to-refresh on a glowing rectangle. Biometrics indicate extreme [dopamine] surge.
He sought the Philosopher's Stone, but his cortex is being [weaponized] by variable-ratio reward code.
Ancient transmutation rituals are obsolete; the Subject is now performing unpaid data labor for an [algorithm].
Willpower cannot override a supercomputer. A structural [override] is required.
To quarantine the code and restore historical dopamine baselines, the Extraction [Protocol] is in the bio.
